zone.query: SELECT h.zone_code as a_code ,h.zone_name as a_name, SUM(pop) AS pop ,SUM(result1) AS result ,SUM(result2) AS result2  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT chw_code,changwatname,zone_code,zone_name FROM ccaatt GROUP BY chw_code,changwatname,zone_code,zone_name) as h LEFT JOIN {{S_TABLE}} as s ON h.chw_code=left(s.areacode,2) AND s.b_year={{YEAR}} WHERE (h.zone_code = {{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{ZONE_CODE}}) GROUP BY h.zone_code,h.zone_name ORDER BY h.zone_code

province.label: จังหวัด
